recommendation: Select editable author definitions with replaceable presentation as the workbench architecture. The fixed-host trials produced new geometry, mappings, local controls and scoped edits from independently authored source. Catalogue assembly alone fails the contract. Use the isolated QuickJS guest as the engineering baseline for authored plotting. Windows reproduced both accepted-output presentations on ef0a1e1 and trusted crosshair endpoints on the separate 5f9f32d chart adapter. The open ef0a1e1 Windows view cleared after registered revocation on the same synthetic profile (run 45331634154). An authorable host-interpreted grammar remains eligible for other presentation needs if it passes the same expressiveness criterion.

remaining_chart_free_journey.create: In the native workbench, start blank and ask the embedded AI to place a selected local research note beside attributed disclosures. Author the text, arrangement and issuer/time condition. For issuer A reviewed at 09:00 UTC, show A at 09:10, exclude A at 08:55 and B at 09:05, and include A at 09:20 on refresh. Selecting a match opens the attributed original through the host under current rights.
remaining_chart_free_journey.edit_and_reopen: Ask the embedded AI to put the newest match first. Preview and accept the edit, refine one element directly, undo, save and reopen. Verify ordering, cutoff and evidence identity. Exercise a second arrangement with a different binding using the same application. A rejected or stalled draft must leave the accepted view usable.
remaining_chart_free_journey.coverage: Distinguish an authorized read with no matches from a disconnected source. Reopen after revocation and check current rights while retaining the user's composition. These steps are pending under the existing M2-013 journey.

ownership.data_and_operations: The Rust registry owns formulas, versioned numeric results, source grants, operation authorization and confirmation. The host binds a selected revision, version, series and result hash under current rights. Finite-or-null observations and exact readouts retain their original UTC keys, with an unknown output unit when the artifact supplies none.
ownership.coordinates: The host projects time and value into the current viewport and supplies trusted crosshair and selection identity. The guest can combine projected anchors with freely positioned geometry in chart-linked or axis-free views.
ownership.presentation: The editable definition owns arrangement, visual mapping and non-privileged interaction. Its rendering backend can be replaced without changing the identity or authority of a data source. Native drawing and selection were observed. Ordinary authored text, evidence arrangement, conditions and local interaction in a reopened user-defined workbench remain part of M2-013. The 900-character bound and geometry-only API describe the prototype.
